entities.name: Implement agent observation correlation
entities.summary: Correlate bounded Langfuse or ClickStack observations with canonical PBK project and work identities without granting telemetry authority.

acceptance: One bounded Langfuse and one bounded ClickStack capture produce deterministic correlation artifacts
Complete captures reject false completeness while incomplete captures remain inspectable
Only explicit PBK attributes can correlate project, work, revision, attempt, or evidence identities
Telemetry cannot mutate canonical work, receipts, priorities, or evidence acceptance
Source digests, bounds, capture state, diagnostics, and unsupported claims remain visible
